profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance. The company's platform helps enterprises discover their AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. According to its website, Credo AI created the AI governance category and now focuses on defining governance for the agentic era, offering what it calls agent governance with registries for every agent, purpose-built agentic risk controls, and integrated governance across existing enterprise stacks.

The Credo AI platform provides ready-to-deploy policy packs for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards, written by team members involved in creating those standards at organizations including ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD. The platform includes GAIA, a govern AI assistant available in the product today, and operates through a Knowledge Graph that fuses global regulatory intelligence with business context. The company states it offers native integrations across 300-plus systems and emphasizes model-level, application-level, and agent-level governance in one platform without bolting AI features onto existing GRC tools.

The held facts show Credo AI operates a single tracked product under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, also called Credo AI, described as purpose-built AI governance with fast deployment capabilities.
